codeSystems.name: v3.ActReason
codeSystems.title: v3 Code System ActReason
codeSystems.description:
A set of codes specifying the motivation, cause, or rationale of an Act, when such rationale is not reasonably represented as an ActRelationship of type "has reason" linking to another Act.  Examples:
Example reasons that might qualify for being coded in this field might be: "routine requirement", "infectious disease reporting requirement", "on patient request", "required by law".

codeSystems.name: v3.ObservationInterpretation
codeSystems.title: v3 Code System ObservationInterpretation
codeSystems.description: One or more codes providing a rough qualitative interpretation of the observation, such as "normal" / "abnormal", "low" / "high", "better" / "worse", "resistant" /  "susceptible", "expected" / "not expected". The value set is intended to be for ANY use where coded representation of an interpretation is needed.
